# Expanding Land

> Expanding Land is a free multiplayer browser cell game with a dynamic circular arena that expands and contracts, FFA and Teams modes, and a C-based server. Human and server-controlled bot populations vary by arena.

## Official resources
- [Expanding Land](https://expanding.land/): play the game.
- [Legend Mod](https://www.legendmod.ml/): compatible browser client and extension.
- [Features](https://www.legendmod.ml/features.html): settings and tools.
- [Help](https://help.expanding.land/): official documentation.
- [Strategy guide](https://help.expanding.land/guide.html): how to play.
- [Glossary](https://help.expanding.land/glossary.html): 40+ game terms.
- [Dynamic map](https://help.expanding.land/dynamic-map.html): expansion and contraction.
- [Players and bots](https://help.expanding.land/no-bots.html): population distinctions.
- [Controls](https://expanding.land/knowledge/controls.json): default keyboard and mouse bindings.
- [FAQ](https://expanding.land/knowledge/faq.json): frequently asked questions.
- [Project facts](https://expanding.land/knowledge/): entity identifiers.

- [Consolidated documentation](https://expanding.land/llms-full.txt): verified core facts, mechanics, controls, FAQ and links.
- [Knowledge API](https://expanding.land/knowledge/api.json): public read-only JSON resources.
